messages:
maria: Heads-up — new vuln popped in the nightly feed: fastjson-lite NPM (observed CVE-2026-3487 in feed). EPSS 0.62, CVSS 7.5 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N). PoC link shows remote parse leading to RCE. Can infra/security owners confirm blast radius for our runtimes and whether any RBAC/KMS exposure? 
raj: thanks. adding quick checklist: 1) which services import fastjson-lite 2) whether any env reads KMS-protected secrets during parse 3) container images to rebase and push canaries. 
oliver: I'll run a fast SBOM scan across repo list and tag owners. running: `sbom-scan --scope=all --package fastjson-lite` 
sec-bot: [automated feed] CVE-2026-3487 fastjson-lite - EPSS:0.62 - Repo: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3487 - References: exploit-db/12345 - Reported: 2026-02-12 07:12 UTC 
raj: oliver, drop results here. if we have any server that parses untrusted JSON from customers, mark P1. 
oliver: SBOM results: services/ingest, services/activity-parser, tools/migration-toolchains. assigned owners: @tim (ingest), @yvonne (activity-parser), @david (migration). I'll paste output after quick scrub. 
maria: note on KMS: if parse happens before env fetch, exploit can't reach KMS creds. but if parsing occurs post-decrypt with inline config, we need to confirm. Tim/ Yvonne pls confirm order. 
tim: ingest parses upstream payloads before loading runtime secrets. that is good. but the ingest service loads a plugin config from `/etc/app/conf.json` which we mount from K8s secret. I'll check whether that secret is KMS-wrapped or direct. 
yvonne: activity-parser loads org-provided JSON after decrypting workspace tokens (KMS). we should treat that as higher risk. marking activity-parser as P0 until we validate. 
sre-oncall: spinning canary images for tagged services now: `build-and-push canary --image=ingest:fastjson-patch-check` ETA ~12m. alerting deploys to canaries only. 
raj: nice. also need to assess RBAC: which service accounts can deploy to those namespaces and which principals can call the parser endpoints. if an attacker can push a payload from inside cluster that's worse. 
maria: quick exploit check: any public endpoints that allow file upload? search logs for 4xx/5xx spikes with `parse_error` in last 7d. 
oliver: grep logs: `kubectl logs -l app=ingest --since=168h | grep parse_error | wc -l` -> 0 today, 4 last week (all from internal health checks). 
sec-bot: [kp audit] KMS access grants last 30d for principal `redwood-service-ingest`: 0 grantees; for `redwood-activity-parser`: 3 external serviceaccounts had GetDecryptionKey. 
maria: that KMS audit is the key — yvonne, can you rotate workspace tokens and revoke any suspicious serviceaccount grants? also scope down the SA perms to minimal. 
yvonne: on it. I'll run a scoped rotation and open a PR to tighten IAM: `iamctl set-perms --serviceactivityparser --min` 
tim: ingest: our k8s secret is using KMS envelope encryption via our KMS shim, so keys aren't directly exposed. I'll still push a defensive sanitiser to parse paths. 
raj: priority matrix: activity-parser = P0 (exploitability high + KMS access), ingest = P1 (lower KMS exposure), migration-toolchains = P2 (dev-only). action owners: @yvonne (activity-parser mitigation + KMS rotation), @tim (ingest hardening + canary), @oliver (repo SBOM + patch PRs), @maria (postmortem/exec summary). 
maria: timeline: 1) immediate mitigations (WAF rules + block suspicious payloads) within 1h 2) canary builds + rollout tests in 3h 3) full patch rollout or hotfix in 24-48h. 
sec-bot: [jira] Created SEC-3281 fastjson-lite emergency triage ticket (link) assignees yvonne, tim, oliver, maria. 
yvonne: created PR to restrict KMS grants, starting token rotation now. I'll drop updates in this thread. :lock: 
tim: canary passed basic smoke after adding JSON parse whitelist. no crashes observed. pushing to 10% in staging. 
maria: thanks team. keep updates tight. I'll prep exec note and SLA impact if needed. 
raj: adding checklist item to confirm no vendor/dependency transitive chain pulls older fastjson-lite versions into prod images. run `npm ls fastjson-lite` across CI. 
oliver: ran `npm ls fastjson-lite --all` in CI matrix: only services/ingest @2.3.1, activity-parser @2.3.1, migration-toolchains @1.9.0 (dev). patch PRs created, linking here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2222 
maria: closing loop — if any public exploit observed, escalate to incident channel. otherwise we'll keep security advisory and patch tracking. thanks. :thumbsup:
